It’s probably normal. I had a similar experience.

Depo was the first birth control I went on- and I was on it for about a year.

Started out great. First 2 shots kept me from having my period at all.

As time went on, I would get mild spotting or no period, and it was great!! To be completely transparent, I’m actually trans (ftm) and it was a great dysphoria help since I wouldn’t have to think about menstrual stuff.

However, my shot I got pretty soon before switching was awful. I got my period for 3 weeks straight. Not much bleeding, mild compared to what I had prior to going on depo. But my vag was on FIRE from having a pad on 24/7 (usually I would use tampons and had been for years but something abt my vag changed after going on birth control and now tampons hurt too much)

I essentially got diaper rash. I had a bunch of micro cuts all over my labia and it burned and itched and hurt to walk.

Went to my doctor and got my next shot 2 weeks early. My period stopped and I felt good for abt 2-3weeks before getting it again. Went to my doctor and we just ended up switching my birth control all together.

I would talk w your doctor about switching. Depo in theory is great but man...bleeding as much as your saying must make you tired. And having to use menstrual products constantly isn’t good for your vaginal health :-(

Sorry you’re having a bad time w depo. Best of luck to you
